author: The Infographics Show
description:
War is now moving faster than human thought, and as the U.S. conflict with Iran heats up, AI combat systems are being relied in a way previous battles could have never imagined. In today's new episode, we explore how the US military’s Project Maven and AI systems from tech giants like Palantir have redefined the battlefield during the 2026 war in Iran. With the ability to execute 2,000 strikes in just four days, the "Kill Chain" is being automated at a terrifying scale.

But what happens if AI makes a mistake? Don't miss as we break down the mechanics of machine-speed warfare and the "slippery slope" that leads to autonomous machines deciding who lives and who dies.

0:00 - Algorithms of Death
0:41 - The Speed of Modern War
1:42 - The Evolution of Combat
3:06 - What is Project Maven?
4:43 - Solving the Data Flood
5:34 - How the "Kill Chain" Works
7:19 - Palantir’s Target Lists
8:33 - 2,000 Strikes in 4 Days
9:56 - Mastering the OODA Loop
10:57 - When AI "Hallucinates"
12:33 - The 2026
title: AI is Now CHOOSING Targets. The Kill Chain is BROKEN
